The editorial, published on Sunday, September 6, and headlined “speak with respect”, referred to the altercation between VD Satheesan and a local Congress leader in Thiruvananthapuram and criticised the Keralam CM. The editorial said those who supported VD Satheesan did not properly understand the Islamic concept about women. “Satheesan’s response to the issue was based on an incomplete understanding, like that of the blind man touching an elephant, fed to him by some people from within the Muslim community itself. They have also failed to understand the Prophet correctly, as the liberator who came at a time when women were treated as slaves and baby girls were buried alive simply for being born,” the editorial said.
